Sophia: Quick sync — Aurora enterprise POC timeline. SE asks going live with customer test harness week of 4/21. Need to confirm owners and blockers.
Juan: I can own server-side integration (webhooks + retry logic). ETA for staging endpoint by 4/17 if network creds arrive.
Adrienne: I'll take client-side SDK integration + sample app. Plan to have v0.1 by 4/18 for demos.
Ben: Eng infra question — do we have a dedicated Dedicated pool for this customer or use hosted? Affects capacity SLO.
Sophia: @ben, Sales expects Dedicated for SLA; legal may require private routing. Ops: confirm by EOD 4/12.
Maya: Security checklist — need SAML metadata and certs. Customer says they can provide next Tuesday. I'll own cert ingestion.
Juan: Blocker: staging VPN request (ticket #4567) still pending. @deploy-bot any ETA?
deploy-bot: Ticket 4567 assigned to net-eng, estimated 48h
Juan: Great, that works — I’ll schedule endpoint deploy after VPN is live.
Adrienne: Success criteria reminder from customer: 1) inference latency < 300ms p95 on 1k qps sim, 2) deterministic output on their test suite, 3) data residency in eu-west-1.
Ben: For latency we should configure batching and kv cache. I'll prototype quantized model on dedicated by 4/15.
Sophia: Ownership matrix: Sales: Sophia, SE: Juan, SDK: Adrienne, Infra perf: Ben, Security: Maya. Can folks ack?
Juan: Ack — I'll add checklist items to the POC Confluence and ping next steps.
Adrienne: Ack — will upload sample app and test vectors by 4/18.
Maya: Ack — will coordinate SAML + cert ingestion and run a quick audit once in staging.
Ben: Ack — will share perf config and run load tests on 4/16.
Sophia: One last ask — engineering code review for the webhook retry change. @ben @juan can we get a quick CR by 4/14?
Juan: Yes, I'll open a PR today and tag reviewers.
Ben: I'll review, might comment on idempotency headers.
Sophia: Perfect. I'll update the customer timeline after these acks. Thanks team :rocket:
